title: Save snapshot: one device's save for one child in one game
description: The game's own save, unchanged, in a wrapper. Uploaded with PUT /v1/children/{child}/games/{game}/snapshots/{dev}. The server keeps the latest per device. A restore downloads every device's snapshot for the child and merges them in the game (games/acorn-math/README.md says how for Acorn).

rev.description: +1 each time this device writes this profile's save.

save_schema.description: The game's save schema name, such as acorn.save.

save.description: The game's save document, opaque to the server.
